reasoning: This is a centralized error notification workflow that triggers when other workflows fail. The Error Trigger node catches failures from across the automation suite, then sends detailed error reports via Gmail to 'dlschoolautomations@gmail.com'. The email template includes workflow name, execution URL, error message, stack trace, and last executed node - providing comprehensive debugging information. With 40 executions and 85% success rate, this suggests the automation platform experiences regular failures that need monitoring. The 15% failure rate of the error workflow itself is concerning as it creates a monitoring gap. The workflow is tagged as 'Reference' and belongs to 'FairTix Automations' project, indicating this is infrastructure supporting a ticketing business.
name: Automation Error Alerting System

The detailed error reports including stack traces and execution URLs suggest a sophisticated technical operation that relies heavily on automation reliability. With regular executions indicating ongoing system failures, this workflow is critical for maintaining operational visibility and preventing silent automation failures from impacting business processes.
